title: KnowledgeOps

tests.name: retrieval_evaluation
tests.method: Hand-authored synthetic questions held out from search corpus and runtime prompts. Same author as corpus; not an independent enterprise benchmark.

tests.name: python_dependencies_and_container_scan
tests.scope: No reported Python dependency vulnerabilities; zero HIGH/CRITICAL container findings in recorded scans. Not a security guarantee.

tests.name: public_https_api
checks: page trailing slash assets and CSP

tests.name: vps_restart_and_restore
tests.details: Six completed runs persisted across API/worker/database restart. Separate restore matched 25 documents and 46 chunks and returned a cited answer.

tests.name: exact_deployed_image_scans
tests.limitation: Trivy 0.73 and recorded advisory data; Alpine 3.24 EOL lookup warning; not proof against unknown vulnerabilities.

benchmarks.name: retrieval_local
benchmarks.scope: Local PostgreSQL connection acquisition + permission-filtered retrieval + Python ranking. Excludes HTTP and queue; not sustained VPS capacity.

benchmarks.name: http_workflow_local
benchmarks.scope: Local HTTP submission through durable queue to successful cited result, including 50ms polling granularity; 4 sessions x 8 runs; not sustainable VPS capacity.

costs.scope: hosting allocation, ingestion CPU cost and per-query infrastructure cost

limits: Original synthetic corpus and same-author evaluation; no enterprise workload validation
Live AgentOps content inference remains unsupported and disabled
Published latency probes were local, not a sustained VPS capacity test
Independent review, screen-reader audit, remote CI and public repository publication not performed
Backups are verified on-host; no new off-host backup schedule or external monitoring configured
